# STEMROBIN-184 Figure 55 / 56 Author Record

Role: fresh modern figure author only, same invocation. Scratch outputs only.
No independent review, PASS decision, promotion, lesson binding, answer work,
backend action, Git action, app server, dependency change or image generation.
Existing parent contexts are read-only and were not rebuilt.

## Source Inventory Frozen Before FigureSpec

Source images opened individually at original detail once each, in order 55, 56.
Image loads so far: 2. Total permitted in this context: exactly 8.
No other source, crop, modern predecessor or independent-review artifact opened.

### Figure 55

Source SHA-256: 6f203be966b1afd76d7937ac2784d2663361e831eac293503d3163265375ce2e.
Original canvas: 1089 x 1215. Three tetrahedron panels, top-left a,
top-right b, lower c. Cyrillic panel letters are modernized to Latin a/b/c.
Every panel has vertices A/B/C/D, solid AB/AC/AD/BD/CD and dashed BC.
No arrowheads, dimensions, numerical givens, equal-length or right-angle marks.
The shape is a spatial schematic, not a source-fitted metric model.

- Panel a: 14 named points A B C D E F G H M N P N_1 P_1 K.
  E on AB; F on AC; H on BD; G on CD.
  M on EF; N on EH; P on FG. D/N/N_1 collinear with N_1 on AB;
  D/P/P_1 collinear with P_1 on AC.
  K lies outside the tetrahedron to the left, common to NP, N_1P_1 and EF
  extended through M. The section is EFGH, not a triangle.
  Construction D-N_1 and D-P_1, extended N-P through K, and base construction
  N_1-P_1 through K are visible. EH/FG are solid; EF/HG and BC are dashed
  where hidden. Extensions outside the tetrahedron are solid; the in-base
  N_1P_1 guide is dashed. Plane alpha is labelled inside the section.
  Diagonal hatching identifies the section; it is not a numerical datum.
- Panel b: 11 named points A B C D E F G H M N P.
  E on AB; F on AC; H on BD; G on CD; M on EF; N on EH; P on FG.
  NP is parallel to EF and lies above it in the displayed quadrilateral EFGH.
  EH/FG are solid, EF/HG/NP and BC are dashed where hidden.
  Plane alpha and diagonal section hatching are present.
  There are no K, N_1 or P_1 in this panel.
- Panel c: 13 named points A B C D E F G M N P N_1 P_1 K.
  E on AB; F on AC; G on AD (not CD, and not H).
  The actual section is the triangle EFG.
  M on EF; N on EG; P on FG. D/N/N_1 collinear with N_1 on AB;
  D/P/P_1 collinear with P_1 on AC.
  K is outside left and common to extended NP, N_1P_1 and EF through M.
  EG/FG are solid; EF/BC and in-base N_1P_1 are dashed where hidden.
  Construction rays D-N_1 and D-P_1, external continuations through K,
  plane alpha and diagonal hatching are present. No H point or fourth
  section vertex may be introduced.

Total source points: 38. Mathematical point labels: 38; plane labels: 3;
Latin panel labels: 3. Expected total renderer labels: 44.
Stable object IDs will use f55-a-, f55-b-, f55-c- prefixes.
Every point will map to a within-panel executable relationship; every semantic
edge/connector will map to a connects assertion. Section incidence and each
base/edge membership will also receive explicit assertions.

### Figure 56

Source SHA-256: 18b6d23fc5f1cdcb5d6b233929a956854fa501315873dab8c056b70459821c93.
Original canvas: 1149 x 409. Two panels, a left and b right.
Each has a rounded outline of plane alpha, not a metric ellipse or triangle.
No arrowheads, numeric givens, dimensions, perpendicularity or equal-length marks.

  B_1 is above the plane, B is its foot. Two solid connectors A_1-A and B_1-B,
  drawn parallel and down-right. Plane alpha and panel label are present.
  No AB, A_1B_1, requested intersection or extended construction is printed.
- Panel b: six dots A_1 B_1 C_1 A B C. Three solid connectors A_1-A,

  plane outline; all three upper points are above it. Plane alpha and panel

Total source points: 10; connectors: 5; plane outlines: 2; plane labels: 2;

Stable object IDs will use f56-a- and f56-b- prefixes. Each upper/foot pair
will have connects coverage; each foot will also have inside coverage.
Displayed projection direction is schematic, with parallel assertions only,
not a claim about lengths, angles or universally nondegenerate positions.

authoritativeText.text: * 在本题和以后某些习题里，作图均指作出直观图.

133. 已知四面体$ABCD$和分别属于面$ABC$、$ABD$和$ACD$的点$M$、$N$、$P$（但不属于棱）. 作棱锥的截面$MNP$. 解. 分析. 设$(MNP)=\alpha$. 我们来说明怎样作平面$\alpha$同面$ABC$的交（图55）. 点$M$是$\alpha$和$(ABC)$的公共点. 如果$(NP)\nparallel(ABC)$（图55，a），那么平面$ABC$和$\alpha$的第二个公共点可能是直线$NP$和$N_1P_1$的交点，其中$(N_1P_1)=(ABC)\cap(NPD)$. 如果$(NP)\parallel(ABC)$（图55，b），那么平面$\alpha$和$(ABC)$的交线平行于$(NP)$（§7，定理3）.作法.
1) $(N_1P_1)=(NPD)\cap(ABC)$；
2) $K=(N_1P_1)\cap(NP)$（对于$(NP)\nparallel(ABC)$的情形，图55，a）；
3) $(KM)=\alpha\cap(ABC)$，$[EF]=\alpha\cap\triangle ABC$. 如果$(NP)\parallel(ABC)$，那么$[FE]\parallel[NP]$（图55，b）；
4) $(EN)=\alpha\cap(ABD)$，$[EH]=\alpha\cap\triangle ABD$；
5) $(FP)=\alpha\cap(ACD)$，$[FG]=\alpha\cap\triangle ACD$. 截面$EFGH$满足问题的条件.研究. 问题有唯一解（公理4）. 截面可能是四边形（图55a，b）或者是三角形（图55，c）.

Eleven points, quadrilateral EFGH; E/AB F/AC H/BD G/CD; M/EF N/EH P/FG with NP parallel EF. No K/N1/P1. Solid front edges and dashed BC/EF/HG/NP; section alpha and hatching. Latin b replaces source panel letter.

Thirteen points, triangle EFG with G on AD, no H. E/AB F/AC M/EF N/EG P/FG; DNN1 DPP1; exterior K on NP/N1P1/EF. Solid front section/construction and dashed hidden BC/EF/base guide; alpha and hatching. Latin c replaces source panel letter.

133. 已知四面体$ABCD$和分别属于面$ABC$、$ABD$和$ACD$的点$M$、$N$、$P$（但不属于棱）. 作棱锥的截面$MNP$. 解. 分析. 设$(MNP)=\alpha$. 我们来说明怎样作平面$\alpha$同面$ABC$的交（图55）. 点$M$是$\alpha$和$(ABC)$的公共点. 如果$(NP)\nparallel(ABC)$（图55，a），那么平面$ABC$和$\alpha$的第二个公共点可能是直线$NP$和$N_1P_1$的交点，其中$(N_1P_1)=(ABC)\cap(NPD)$. 如果$(NP)\parallel(ABC)$（图55，b），那么平面$\alpha$和$(ABC)$的交线平行于$(NP)$（§7，定理3）.作法.
1) $(N_1P_1)=(NPD)\cap(ABC)$；
2) $K=(N_1P_1)\cap(NP)$（对于$(NP)\nparallel(ABC)$的情形，图55，a）；
3) $(KM)=\alpha\cap(ABC)$，$[EF]=\alpha\cap\triangle ABC$. 如果$(NP)\parallel(ABC)$，那么$[FE]\parallel[NP]$（图55，b）；
4) $(EN)=\alpha\cap(ABD)$，$[EH]=\alpha\cap\triangle ABD$；
5) $(FP)=\alpha\cap(ACD)$，$[FG]=\alpha\cap\triangle ACD$. 截面$EFGH$满足问题的条件.研究. 问题有唯一解（公理4）. 截面可能是四边形（图55a，b）或者是三角形（图55，c）.
